feed.title: NPR Topics: Politics
feed.subtitle: NPR's expanded coverage of U.S. and world politics, the latest news from Congress and the White House and elections.

entry.title: Government spent millions on Trump ads. And, federal agents raid Ilhan Omar's home
entry.summary: The government is using millions of taxpayers' dollars on pro-Trump ads, even after the president said this would not happen. And, federal agents search Rep. Ilhan Omar's D.C. home.

entry.title: Win or lose, independent candidates want to meet voters in the middle
entry.summary: Nearly 200 independent candidates in more than 100 congressional races are trying to prove there's an alternative to the two party system — even though the chance of winning is very low.

entry.title: Voters here will decide whether to force cities to build cheaper, smaller homes
entry.summary: Voters in Massachusetts will decide whether to require cities and towns to allow smaller homes on smaller lots. A growing number of states are doing the same to help ease a housing shortage.

entry.title: Polls are a snapshot, and other helpful things to remember during the midterm elections
entry.summary: With Election Day just a few weeks away — and millions of votes already cast — midterm polls are everywhere. While polling can be a helpful tool to understand the electorate, it's not a crystal ball.

entry.title: Montana ballot measure could undo ruling on corporate spending in state politics
entry.summary: Montana voters will have a chance to speak out on the boom of corporate and anonymous money in politics that has been the result of the Citizens United court ruling.

entry.title: New White House press secretary a 'devoted fan' of Trump and MAGA
entry.summary: Katie Zacharia worked for one of Trump's companies and raised her profile appearing on conservative-leaning talk shows. She also amplified right-wing conspiracy theories. Now she'll be the president's chief spokesperson.

entry.title: Government spent $10 million on pro-Trump ads after president said super PAC would fund
entry.summary: Nearly $22 million in taxpayers funds has been spent to air the ads, with nearly half spent after Trump promised to fund what the White House calls public service announcements through his super PAC.

entry.title: Agents search Rep. Omar's D.C. home; DOJ says it's part of criminal investigation
entry.summary: The Justice Department says the search is part of an "ongoing federal investigation," while Omar calls it "an attempt to target political enemies."

entry.title: Democratic senator talks Trump's Russian diesel deal
entry.summary: NPR's Steve Inskeep speaks to Democratic Senator Jeanne Shaheen of New Hampshire about President Trump's deal for Russian diesel and his claim of an "energy ceasefire" that did not materialize.

entry.title: Political strategist on how Trump's personal grievances could affect the GOP
entry.summary: NPR's Steve Inskeep speaks with political strategist and former senior Republican congressional adviser Rina Shah about how President Trump's personal grievances and projects are affecting the chances of GOP candidates in the upcoming election.
